summary.text: DIGITAL ØKONOMI AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2019-03-25. Its registered activity: "Regnskapstjenester og bedriftsrådgivning." Its main industry code is 69.202 (regnskapsføring og bokføring). The register shows 7 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 6 275 376 NOK and the annual result was 307 583 NOK; operating income was down from 8 305 423 NOK in 2024. Registered leadership: Waqar Ahmad (daglig leder and styrets leder). Its verified website is digitalokonomi.no, which links to its Facebook profile. Recent changes in the register: latest filed accounts year set to 2025 on 2026-07-25; employees set to 7 on 2026-03-11.
